# env/components-creds.example.txt — infra-creds template for 13-order (### NN_Service format).
#
# REAL secrets go in env/components-creds.txt (GITIGNORED) — never in this committed
# .example file. Workflow:
#   cp env/components-creds.example.txt env/components-creds.txt
#   $EDITOR env/components-creds.txt        # paste your REAL infra creds (the full ### dump)
#   chmod 600 env/components-creds.txt
#   ./env/init-env.sh .env.dev             # renders env/.env.dev
#
# init-env.sh reads env/components-creds.txt (gitignored). Paste your FULL infra status
# dump (all ### blocks); 13-order uses only these:
#   01_PostgreSQL 02_MongoDB 04_Redis 05_Kafka 07_Elastic_APM 16_Temporal.
# Other blocks are ignored — including 03_Elasticsearch (:9201), which is the
# search/review business ES used ONLY by 05-search + 08-review. The application
# LOG-SINK ES is the APM-stack ES (block 07, `elasticsearch` :9200 line + elastic-pass).
#
# VERIFY-ONLY: 13-order verifies JWTs with auth's PUBLIC key and authenticates
# east-west calls with the shared token — both are pasted into the '### Auth_Identity'
# block below (from 01-auth's rendered .env.dev). Order never holds the private key
# and never mints a keypair. (Fallback: AUTH_PUBLIC_KEY_B64/AUTH_INTERNAL_TOKEN env
# vars, or AUTH_ENV_FILE pointing at the deployed 01-auth's .env.dev.)

### 01_PostgreSQL
   endpoint       postgresql://<user>:<password>@<host>:5432/postgres
   host:port      <host>:5432
   user           <user>
   password       <password>

### 02_MongoDB
   endpoint       mongodb://<user>:<password>@<host>:27017/?authSource=admin
   host:port      <host>:27017
   user           <user>
   password       <password>

### 04_Redis
   endpoint       redis://default:<password>@<host>:6379/0
   host:port      <host>:6379
   user           default
   password       <password>

### 05_Kafka
   bootstrap      <host>:9092
   ui             http://<host>:8080
   auth           none (PLAINTEXT)

# --- 07's `elasticsearch` line (:9200) is the application LOG-SINK ES + APM stack. ---
### 07_Elastic_APM
   elasticsearch  http://elastic:<elastic-pass>@<host>:9200
   apm-ingest     http://<host>:8200  (Bearer token)
   apm-token      <apm-bearer-token>
   kibana-ui      http://<host>:5601  (login: elastic)
   elastic-pass   <elastic-pass>

### 16_Temporal
   grpc           <host>:7233
   web-ui         http://<host>:8233
   auth           none

# --- Auth_Identity: paste from 01-auth's rendered .env.dev (verify-only — NOT minted here). ---
### Auth_Identity
   auth_service_public_key   <paste 01-auth .env.dev JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_B64>
   internal_service_token    <paste 01-auth .env.dev INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN>
